notes: Built by clean.py from the pinned Perseus commit in metadata.json, which it verifies by checksum; `python3 clean.py --check` reproduces this file byte for byte. Euclid's text alone: the definitions, postulates, common notions and propositions of the 13 books, a paragraph per line; each item (a definition, postulate, common notion or proposition) separated from the next by a blank line, books by two. Heath's introductions, notes, headings, figures, daggers, citations and the Greek he quotes are dropped; the words he supplies and the passages he brackets as interpolated stay, in his brackets. No train/test split: consumers split it (indrajala-ml: the first 90% for training, the last 10% held out).
